principles: Protect the sealed solution and private evidence at all times.
Apply explicit Killer In The Keep exceptions before general SRD rules.
Give every active hero meaningful turns during exploration, combat, and deduction.
Use monsters, traps, storm stages, and rest consequences to create pressure without invalidating logical deduction.
Never let a bot read the solution, another player’s private hand, or private notes.
Provide at least two counterplays for every trap.
Use accessibility symbols in addition to color.
Record deterministic hidden-information events for dispute review without exposing them to clients.
setup_checklist: Fill to six adventurers when needed
Generate and seal one suspect, one weapon, and one room
Place tokens and start storm stage
adjudication_order: Make a fair ruling that preserves hidden information
ai_director: Controls monsters, hazards, witnesses, and ambient events.
Maintains legal movement, line of sight, action economy, and hidden information.
Adjusts encounter pressure based on party size and progress.
Never changes the solution after the run begins.
Provides optional rules explanations without revealing deductions.
network_authority: Server-authoritative solution, dice, damage, inventory, evidence, and turn order.
Host migration for peer-hosted private games.
No duplicated heroes in the same active run.
suggestion_algorithm: Validate that the active token is in a room.
Validate that the named room equals the active token's room.
Move the named suspect and weapon pieces into that room.
Check opponents in turn order beginning immediately after the active player.
For each opponent, calculate matching cards.
If no match exists, record a pass and continue.
If one or more matches exist, require that player to choose exactly one.
Reveal the chosen card only to the suggester unless a special card says otherwise.
If all opponents pass, record the unanswered suggestion state.
Apply the edition's accusation timing rule.
accusation_algorithm: Validate that the investigator is eligible to accuse under the selected rules profile.
Validate that the investigator has not already made a strict final accusation.
Validate any configured room or location requirement.
Accept exactly one suspect, one weapon, and one room.
Compare all three IDs against the server-only solution.
If all three match, resolve victory according to the selected playstyle.
If any differ, apply the selected incorrect-accusation consequence without revealing the solution.
Keep the incorrect accuser's evidence hand available for future ordered disproval when strict classic consequences are enabled.
If no eligible investigator can still win, resolve the configured unsolved ending.
